type.description: Skill classification. Orchestrator coordinates other skills; Task completes one concrete unit of work.

actor.description: Primary role responsible for owning or executing the generated skill.

AIDriven.description: Whether the new Task skill relies primarily on AI instead of deterministic scripts. Ignored for Orchestrator skills.

usesTemplates.description: Whether the new skill needs reusable files under templates/. Typically applies to Task skills.

responsibility.description: A single-sentence statement of the new skill's core responsibility.

flowSummary.description: Brief summary of the main flow. For Orchestrator skills, list the sub-skill sequence and major decision points. For Task skills, list the major processing stages.

inputContractJson.description: JSON object to write into the new skill's in.json. This object must describe the input schema, not runtime input values.

outputContractJson.description: JSON object to write into the new skill's out.json. This object must describe the output schema, not runtime output values.
